mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 growth is negative and HOUST declines, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply shocks characterized by INDPRO below 90 for 3 consecutive months, S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over 60 trading days due to heightened recession risks and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90 for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL falls below 210, it signals deflationary pressures that reduce corporate pricing power and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 210, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) falls below 350,000 (thousands of dollars), it indicates a contraction in consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is below 350000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE increase > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is below 0.5% and UNRATE rises by >0.2pp, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns defined by INDPRO growth below 0.5% for 3 months, S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over 60 trading days due to reduced corporate investment and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
